definitions.explanation: An extended period of abnormally hot weather that affects a region. Often used in news reports about extreme weather events.

examples.japanese: {熱波|ねっぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{熱波|ねっぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{襲|おそ}った→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: A record-breaking heat wave hit Europe.

examples.japanese: {熱波|ねっぱ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急増|きゅうぞう}している→急増する：26999_kyuuzousuru⟧。
examples.english: The number of heatstroke patients is surging due to the heat wave.

notes:
A meteorological term that has become increasingly common in Japanese news as extreme heat events grow more frequent. The term combines ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat) and {波|ぱ} (wave).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱波|ねっぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧ — a heat wave strikes
- {熱波|ねっぱ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ — the effects of a heat wave
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{熱波|ねっぱ} — a record heat wave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ — intense heat, severe heat (describes the heat itself, not the weather pattern)
- ⟦{酷暑|こくしょ}→酷暑：08324_kokusho⟧ — extreme/brutal heat (stronger than ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧)
- ⟦{寒波|かんぱ}→寒波：12354_kanpa⟧ — cold wave (the opposite weather phenomenon)
